draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Bogmalo! This little village sits in a small bay with about a mile of curving sand, just 4 km from Dabolim Airport. It's generally very quiet, which makes it a lovely spot to rest before or after a flight.
draft.hungryLine: A handful of restaurants line the beachfront, and some of the smaller ones will set up a candlelit table on the sand for you.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Naval Aviation Museum is about 10 minutes away, with decommissioned military aircraft outside and a two-storey gallery inside.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Grab a seat at a beachfront restaurant for the sunset, Bogmalo is known for beautiful ones.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Half a dozen cows turn up on the beach mid-afternoon and wander back up the road as soon as the sun sets.

spots.name: Naval Aviation Museum
spots.detail: 10 min walk · History of India's Naval Air Arm, with real aircraft on show

spots.name: Dabolim Airport
spots.detail: 22 min walk · Goa's first airport, inside the INS Hansa naval base

tips.title: Stay for sunset.
tips.body: Bogmalo is famous for its sunsets, best watched from one of the beachfront bars.

tips.title: Book boat trips at Full Moon.
tips.body: Trips to the islands and for dolphin spotting can be booked at the Full Moon restaurant at the south end of the beach.

story.title: Navy wings
story.body: The Indian Navy's air arm has flown from nearby INS Hansa, India's biggest naval airbase. The Naval Aviation Museum tells that story with aircraft used since Independence.

story.title: Goa's first airport
story.body: Dabolim Airport, the first airport in Goa, runs as a civil enclave inside INS Hansa. Its integrated terminal opened in December 2013.

story.title: A quieter sky
story.body: In 2023 some big UK flights moved to Goa's new second airport. Since then traffic at Dabolim has been declining.

story.title: A sleepy bay
story.body: Bogmalo stays a small, quiet beach village despite the airport next door. It even hosts AIESEC India conferences every June or July.

food.name: Joets
food.detail: A bit more upmarket, at the north end of the beach

food.name: Full Moon
food.detail: Upmarket spot at the south end, also books boat trips
